newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds ended slightly higher on Wednesday after a dull session spent tracking a bullish Italian market, although with less conviction, dealers said.
"BTPs are impressivly strong. Bonos are steady but we really underperformed the Italian market," a Madrid-based dealer said.
Chartists added that after Wednesday's weak session, the future could overcome the 117 level soon, then aiming at next strong resistance at 117.10.
But other dealers said it was unlikely that the Spanish 10-year spread over Bunds would fall below 60 basis points.
